title: agent.completions.response.UpstreamDurationMs
description:
Wall-clock duration spent inside each upstream client, in
milliseconds. Each upstream measures its own create→finish elapsed
per call and stamps its field on its terminal usage chunk; the
aggregators sum per-field across turns, fallbacks, and (at the
vector/function layers) across parallel agents. A field is `None`
when that upstream was never used.

claude_agent_sdk.description: Milliseconds spent in the Claude Agent SDK upstream.

codex_sdk.description: Milliseconds spent in the Codex SDK upstream.

openrouter.description: Milliseconds spent in the OpenRouter upstream.

script.description:
Milliseconds spent in the Script upstream (client-side script
execution over the reverse channel).
